kanzlei_content.p1: The world today is shaped by transnational and multicultural relationships. Our attorneys are admitted to practise in Switzerland and, in each case, in at least one other EU country. Against this background, we offer client-oriented solutions for complex international legal matters, particularly those relating to Switzerland, Spain, Romania, Hungary, Finland, and Latin America.
kanzlei_content.p2: IRAZ brings together independent attorneys under one roof in Zurich. The attorneys Claudia Gafner-Rojas, Daniela Camelia Costea, and Anett Iltanen form an office-sharing association of independent attorneys, each acting in her own name. The attorneys bear sole responsibility towards their clients and are not liable for one another. Our clients decide for themselves which attorney should support them in their matters in a targeted and solution-oriented manner.
kanzlei_content.p3: Our law office is located in an attractive area of Zurich’s Seefeld district, just a few minutes’ walk from Stadelhofen station and Lake Zurich. In addition to the main office in Zurich, our attorneys also have their own law offices in Barcelona, Spain; Cluj-Napoca, Romania; and Szeged, Hungary.

claudia.bio:
Claudia Gafner-Rojas advises and represents private individuals in complex family law and inheritance law matters with an international dimension.

A particular focus of her work lies in cross-border family situations, especially in the areas of surrogacy, recognition of children, international marriages, divorces, as well as international estate planning and inheritance disputes. In addition, she assists clients with selected issues of international real estate law.

Her advice combines legal precision with strategic foresight and a strong understanding of sensitive personal situations.

Thanks to her international orientation and multilingualism, she supports clients from Switzerland and abroad with discretion, clarity, and personal commitment.

  • International real estate law

daniela.bio:
Ms. Costea has more than 25 years of experience in legal professions, from 1994 to 2004 as a public prosecutor in Romania, and subsequently as an attorney-at-law in Switzerland and Romania: from 2006 to 2015 in a law firm in Winterthur, from 2015 to 2019 as a partner in a law firm in Zurich, and since January 2020 as a partner at Internationale Rechtsanwälte Zürich. Since 2004, she has also operated her own law office in Cluj-Napoca, Romania.

Ms. Costea has achieved significant successes before the European Court of Human Rights in Strasbourg, as legal representative of a renowned Swiss pharmaceutical company based in Basel, in several company formations involving real estate acquisitions between Romania and Switzerland, as well as in highly complex inheritance proceedings between Switzerland and Romania.

Ms. Costea represents Swiss and Romanian clients before all courts and authorities, both in Switzerland and in Romania.

With her doctoral dissertation entitled “EU Acquis relating to Freedom of Movement”, Ms. Costea was awarded the doctoral degree in 2020.
